desc: Browning Buck Mark rimfire pistol has lead the industry in quality, reliability, accuracy and variety. It starts with a piece of aircraft-grade 7075 aluminum alloy, and then is CNC machined to exacting tolerances. The crisp single-action trigger, hand reamed chamber, target crowned barrel and finely adjustable target sights mean the Buck Mark comes ready for fun straight from the box. The slide features built-in recess and raised side panels for better grip, and a convenient manual slide release which is easily operated with the shooting or support hand. It also has grooves plus slide cocking "ears" at the rear making racking the slide back even more convenient. The Buck Mark also utilizes a large manual safety and mag release adjacent to the trigger guard. This Plus model features a Vision barrel with a tensioned outer aluminum sleeve surrounding a strong steel inner barrel that is also suppressor ready. It also has Picatinny optics rail, muzzle brake, UFX overmolded grips, TRUGLO/Marble Arms fiber-optic front sight and 16-click adjustable Pro-Target rear sight. Includes two magazines and a pistol rug.
